input: Natural B128 reader words, low lane before high, 64-bit H_I/H_Q/V_I/V_Q per logical sample

cache.push: one natural word,1 or2 valid lanes; same-edge retired lane credit in fine_sample_cache_2
cache.pop: one or two chronological logical samples per handshake; last lane_count=1 when only one remains
cache.peek: one registered indexed lookup; found=0 for unretained/future samples; response held until ready; reads pre-edge state
cache.validation: count 1..16384, exact natural masks/start parity/index/first/last; malformed input invalidates job
cache.abort: local cancellation is immediate; upstream reader MUST separately drain all issued responses before bank release
cache.capacity_scope: 32 samples in Fine local cache; upstream B reader credit FIFO is additional transport buffering

schedule.edge_support: k-3..k+4, EOF clipping only after sample_count samples accepted
schedule.edge_service: bounded RAW coarse neighborhoods +/-8, registered local peek and exact candidate solver with FAST_MATH=1
schedule.retire: retire up to2 samples when processed-base>=29 or tail resolved; keep causality check, pause while resolving crossing candidates
schedule.accumulators: provisional sums are discarded if final timing/source/prior quality is invalid
schedule.proof_scope: Independent batch numerical comparison, every retired IQ sample, natural RAM address/count at latencies1/2/3, held results, cancellation drain, physical16-bank F7 and real instrument FIR/command tests

accumulator.input: one or two chronological samples per accepted clock; lane-specific H/V masks and segment IDs
accumulator.arithmetic: 32 signed16 multiplies for two-lane packet; same exact33-bit product/48-bit sum/46-bit energy formats
accumulator.pairing: adjacent retained logical samples within each polarization; dropped body membership breaks the previous-sample chain
accumulator.hv: H*conj(V) when both masks true; separate H/V energies
accumulator.drain: registered products, registered sum/difference, accumulator; result_valid only after last and both stages empty
accumulator.ownership: result held until release; no new job before release; index or last mismatch invalidates without publishing

legacy_scope: The original fine_sample_cache and fine_segment_accumulator remain one-sample standalone reference components. The active engine uses the _2 variants described below. FinePass is causal, not cycle-exact for this accelerated RTL.
